cohort: 78 pregnancies in 39 women with SLE and an age-matched control group of healthy pregnant women
finding: Pregnant women with SLE have a higher risk of adverse maternal and fetal outcomes, including GDM, hypertension, cesarean delivery, preterm birth, and low birth weight, compared to healthy pregnancies.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with SLE were more likely to deliver via cesarean section compared to pregnant women without SLE.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was measured as an outcome.
